svg.title: M3 chameleon model sheet

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M3 — chubby chameleon mascot · model sheet

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure space 100 × 100 units. Outline 2.2 u everywhere; props 1.8–2.2 u. No neck, no claws, no teeth. Tail always attaches lower-right (mirror whole figure for RTL).

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: pear, 50 u wide at head, 54 u at hips, 70 u tall (crown 18 → ground 88). The head IS the body.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eye turrets: Ø 22 u, centred on the eye axis (y 42), bulging 5 u past the head edge — the signature of the silhouette.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each eye swivels independently (chameleon trait) — used for listening, thinking and curiosity.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crest (casque): soft dome 20 u wide × 9 u tall, accent colour; never pointed.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail: tapered 9 → 2.4 u, inward spiral Ø ~20 u; used as a gesture (wave, point, curl, droop).

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mouth: wide, low (y 60), 24 u span — reads as friendly at 24 px. Limbs: stubby, two-lobed mitten hands/feet.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bands: two accent bands on the flanks + two dots; the body hue shifts per state/course family, bands do not.

text.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SIZE LADDER (24 / 40 / 64 / 96 px) AND GRAYSCALE READ
